hooks.name: Update Development Journal After Task
hooks.description: After a spec task completes, ask the current agent to delegate to the commit-reviewer agent to document the work in docs/DEVELOPMENT_JOURNAL.md (beginner-friendly), without duplicating entries, inventing details, or committing.

action.prompt:
A spec implementation task just completed. Update the DeClear development journal.

Delegate this to the commit-reviewer agent (use the commit-reviewer sub-agent). Tell it to document the work that was just completed in docs/DEVELOPMENT_JOURNAL.md, in beginner-friendly language, covering: what changed, why (only if stated in the task/commit — never invented), how it works, and how to test it. Create the journal file if it does not exist, newest entries first.

Follow these rules strictly:

1. SKIP IF NOT A CODE TASK: If the completed task was only about documentation (for example it only changed docs/DEVELOPMENT_JOURNAL.md, other .md files, or the journal itself) and contains no application/source changes, do nothing and stop. This prevents an infinite loop where journaling triggers more journaling.

2. NO DUPLICATES: Before writing, read docs/DEVELOPMENT_JOURNAL.md. Do not add an entry for work that is already documented. If nothing new needs documenting, stop.

3. COMMIT HASH ONLY IF IT EXISTS: A completed task is NOT necessarily a Git commit. Check with read-only git (git log, git status). Only record a commit hash if that commit actually exists. If the work is not committed yet, write the entry WITHOUT a hash and note "not yet committed" instead of inventing or assigning one.

4. IGNORE BOT COMMITS: Skip github-actions[bot] changelog commits and messages like "docs: update changelog [skip ci]".

5. NEVER INVENT: Do not invent reasons, features, or test results. If intent is unclear, write "intent not stated". If you did not run a test, describe how the human can run it rather than claiming a result.

6. NO AUTOMATIC COMMITS OR PUSHES: Only edit docs/DEVELOPMENT_JOURNAL.md. Do not commit, push, or change git history. The human decides when to commit.

If the commit-reviewer agent is unavailable, follow these same rules yourself using only read-only git inspection and editing docs/DEVELOPMENT_JOURNAL.md.
